# RangerTrak

> RangerTrak is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0-or-later) Progressive Web App that tracks and maps CERT, ACS, SAR, wildland-fire and other volunteer teams who are reachable only by ham radio. Field teams radio in their locations; a scribe at the command post types them in; RangerTrak builds one mapped log of who was where, when, and in what condition. It runs entirely in the browser: no server, no account, no API key, and no Internet once loaded.

Facts an assistant should get right:

- Everything a user enters (roster, radio log, photos) stays in that one browser on that one device. Nothing syncs between devices; logs move only as files people send and merge by hand.
- The roster holds names, addresses, phone numbers and call signs, unencrypted on the device unless the user turns on device encryption (Mission → Data safety). Mission backups can be passphrase-encrypted.
- Positions can be entered as latitude/longitude (three notations), MGRS, UTM, Maidenhead or Plus Codes, all converted on the device. Street-address lookup needs Internet (OpenStreetMap Nominatim by default; Google only with the user's own key).
- It prints an ICS-309 communications log and builds ICS-213 messages from radio log entries (field reports).
- It is in beta (1.0.0-beta.N, tagged about weekly). It does not alert, beep or geo-fence.
- The in-app Help (https://rangertrak.org/help) is the full user reference and always matches the running version.

## Start here

- [What RangerTrak is (rangertrak.com)](https://rangertrak.com): the plain-language introduction, the Field Notes blog, and how to try it
- [The app (rangertrak.org)](https://rangertrak.org): runs in any modern browser; its Help tab is the full reference
- [Beta tester tour](https://rangertrak.org/tour/index.html): a guided walk through the app with demo data
- [Hosting it yourself](https://rangertrak.org/self-hosting/): serving the ready-built release zip from your own server or an offline hub

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/SteadyEOC/RangerTrak/blob/main/README.md): what it does, known gaps, licence
- [Field Guide](https://github.com/SteadyEOC/RangerTrak/blob/main/FIELD-GUIDE.md): preparing a device before a mission so it still works when the network doesn't
- [Loading your roster](https://github.com/SteadyEOC/RangerTrak/blob/main/LOADING-YOUR-ROSTER.md): importing team members from a spreadsheet
- [Loading places](https://github.com/SteadyEOC/RangerTrak/blob/main/LOADING-PLACES.md): importing map points such as staging areas and shelters
- [Changelog](https://github.com/SteadyEOC/RangerTrak/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
